chunks: And with this chain of narrators, he said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
We are the Face of Allah, which does not perish.

key_terms.لَا يَهْلُكُ: Does not perish, indicating eternal existence in contrast to the rest of creation.
key_terms.وَجْهُ اللَّهِ: The Face of Allah, a Quranic term denoting the enduring manifestation of Divine authority and knowledge, applied here to the Imams.

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Imams are the 'Face of Allah' in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In al-Tawhid, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifying the Ahl al-Bayt as the 'Face of Allah' (Wajh Allah), a title denoting their role as the enduring, visible manifestation of Divine authority and knowledge in the world. This interpretation aligns with the Shia exegetical tradition that views the Imams as the eternal spiritual axis (Mahwar) through which God's guidance remains accessible, contrasting their permanence with the transience of all other creation.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 4. And the same chain of narrators that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said: “
We are the Face [wajh] of Allah, which does not perish.”
